processors.name: Supabase
processors.data: your account, your workspace and Community content, and your sign-in session

processors.name: Vercel
processors.data: each request to the site, including your IP address and browser type, and the logs of those requests

processors.name: GitHub Actions
processors.role: Building and testing the platform's own code
processors.data: none of your personal data: it runs on the platform's code, not on member data

processors.name: Resend
processors.data: the invited person's e-mail address and the name of the organisation that invited them
processors.condition: Only when a deployment has an e-mail provider configured. Otherwise an invitation is shared as a link and nothing is sent.

processors.name: OpenStreetMap tile servers
processors.role: Map tiles on the Regulations map
processors.data: your IP address and browser type, when the map loads
